subject: Voices of production efficiency — quick captures for one-pagers
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Voices of production efficiency — quick captures for one-pagers

Team,

We're finalizing a one-pager and a 3-slide mini-deck for the Ava Retail renewal + upsell motion next week. Marketing needs short, attributable customer lines (15–30 words) that speak to production efficiency and unit-cost reduction on inference. Objective: 3 high-confidence quotes we can surface in the one-pager and as callouts in the slide deck.

Asks (short):
- CS (Marissa): can you get 3 customer-approved lines and signed usage consent by EOD Thursday? Preferably one that mentions latency improvements, one for cost/unit, and one for reliability/uptime.
- Sales (Vivek): flag any customer we should prioritize for executive-level quote; I'll take the outreach if needed.
- Marketing (Priyom): I'll send the template for attribution formatting (company + title + short permission language).

Resources: attach a simple CSV template to capture quote, contact, and consent status. Keep the language short — we want tiles for the deck.

Thanks — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Head of Growth Enablement | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
+1 415 555 0191
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Voices of production efficiency — quick captures for one-pagers

Neha — quick status update. I've already scoped three potential snippets from Ava (CS worked them into our customer success notes last month). I reached out to Ellen and Tom this morning to request two things: a short attributable sentence and a quick signed consent (one-line PDF) allowing us to use their quote in sales materials.

Attached: ava_onepager_quote_sheet.csv (draft lines populated), plus a consent form I asked them to sign. If they approve, we'll have the three variants you requested:
- Latency: "Redwood slashed our mean token latency, letting us hit interactive SLAs for shopper personalization." (proposed attribution: Ellen Shelby, VP Engineering, Ava Retail)
- Cost: "Inference unit costs dropped ~37% after switching to Redwood's batching and KV cache—direct impact on our margin per interaction." (proposed attribution: Tom Kline, Head of AI Ops, Ava Retail)
- Reliability: "We saw a measurable drop in production incidents tied to model serving; the fallback policies made our holidays stable." (unattributed internal ops line for compliance)

Note: I asked Ellen specifically if she can provide a 10–12 word version for the one-pager. I'll push for the shorter versions and get the signed consent.

Attachments: ava_onepager_quote_sheet.csv (draft), consent_request_email-thread.pdf (internal reference).

Marissa,

Happy to help — thanks for being specific on what you need. Tom and I reviewed the proposed lines. We're comfortable with the three variants provided; I made a tiny tweak to the latency line to be slightly less technical. Please see my approvals below (and I've attached a scanned one-line consent so you have signed permission).

Approved lines (shortened where possible):
- Latency (Ellen Shelby, VP Engineering, Ava Retail): "Redwood cut interactive latency so our personalization stays real-time."
- Cost (Tom Kline, Head of AI Ops, Ava Retail): "Unit inference costs fell ~37% after Redwood optimizations—meaningful margin upside."
- Reliability (Ava Retail Ops): "Fallback routing kept our holiday traffic steady; we avoided cascading outages."

Attached: consent_signed_avaretail.pdf (one-line permission: "Ava Retail grants Redwood Inference permission to use the above quotes in marketing and sales materials, with attribution as listed.")

If you need executive headshots or a logo release form, flag it and I'll loop in our comms legal.

Thanks — Ellen

Next steps (I'll own):
- Priyom: I'll drop the finalized 10–12 word tiles into the one-pager template and send a preview by EOD tomorrow.
- Marissa: please add the signed permission (consent_signed_avaretail.pdf) to our shared Drive folder and update the CSV status to "approved".
- Vivek: I'll share the deck with sales leadership during the renewal prep call; mark anything that needs exec-level attention.

If anyone sees compliance/legal flags on the consent wording, ping me and I'll escalate. Otherwise we'll ship these tiles into the renewal materials.
